final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink COLLATE BINARY = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT s1.translink, s1.ordertypedist, s1.record_count, 1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.total_count FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY = s2.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY 1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.total_count DESC LIMIT 10
